ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) surface; high-intensity (white) pixels are localized and constitute approximately 5-10% of the visible area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid low-intensity base across both lobes. High-contrast white mottling is concentrated at the distal tips, with a dense, contiguous cluster on the left lobe tip and more dispersed speckling on the right lobe tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with a narrow vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the trailing edge of both lobes. The left lobe trailing edge features a more irregular, jagged profile compared to the right.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edges with a posterior sweep towards tapered, acute distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast white circular pixel clusters visible at the distal tips of both lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization or scarring patterns.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct light-colored vertical linear marks located centrally on the fluke surface, just below the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular jaggedness and apparent loss of edge continuity at the distal tip of the left lobe; white scarring clusters at both lobe extremities.
